name: capell-app/record-switcher
description: A Switch record menu under the title of Capell admin edit screens for pages, layouts, sites, sections, widgets and menus.

healthChecks.label: Record Switcher heading extender and admin assets are available

marketplace.summary: Search for another page, layout, site or menu from the edit screen you are on and jump straight to it, without going back to the list.
marketplace.description: Add a searchable Switch record menu to Capell admin edit screens for pages, layouts, sites, sections, widgets and menus. Page results are grouped by related pages, this site and other sites, and show each page's site and address. Only records the person can edit appear.
marketplace.problem: I have to go back to the page tree between each page I edit.
marketplace.outcome: Editors jump to the next page from the edit screen with a search.

faq.question: Do I need to set anything up?
faq.answer: No. It works with Capell Admin and has nothing to set up or switch on.

faq.question: Does switching save the page I'm leaving?
faq.answer: No. The menu doesn't save the item you're leaving, so save before you switch.

faq.question: Which things can I switch between?
faq.answer: Pages, layouts, sites, sections, widgets and menus, each listing others of its own kind. You only see items you're allowed to edit, and the menu stays hidden when there's nothing else to switch to.

faq.question: In what order are other pages suggested?
faq.answer: Related pages that share a site and a parent come first, then other pages on this site, then pages on other sites. Typing narrows the list by page name, parent names or public address, and ten results show at a time.
